component.name: Ferricone Player
component.summary: A redesigned VLC-based media player with a library beside the video

description.p: Ferricone plays videos, music and network streams on VLC's own engine, libVLC 4, with a new interface after Juxtopposed's "VLC Redesign".

ul.li: A library dock and full library with watched progress, music by album and artist, and saved streams
A settings sidebar with presets that stick per folder
A subtitle timeline on the seek bar, Add Subtitles with OpenSubtitles, and casting
Light, dark and system themes, any accent color, and Omarchy's colors where installed
